arguments.title: Arguments
arguments.description: Tool arguments. E.g. {"address":"0x..."} for portfolio risk, {"coin":"BTC"} for Polymarket divergence.

mcpServerUrl.title: MCP server URL
mcpServerUrl.description: Your deployed HyperSignal MCP endpoint (leave default unless self-hosting elsewhere).

mcpApiKey.title: MCP API key (PRO)
mcpApiKey.description: A PRO key on your server. Stored encrypted. (Or set MCP_API_KEY as an env var instead to hide it from public runs.)
